submission.natural_language_explanation: L7/N1485+ is a retrospective 'connective-slot' detector: it fires on the closed-class token that links a predicate or a quantity to its modifier - the agent/means preposition ' by' after a participle ('guided by', 'blocked by', 'made stronger by'), a causal or conditional subordinator ('because', 'due to', 'so long as'), the negation/quantifier operator inside such a phrase ('no amount of', 'not permitted'), or the pivot of a quantity/composition frame ('a wing length of', 'a combination of', 'by virtue of') - and it peaks where that token completes a formulaic multi-word connective (by-label lift 9.9x, subordinator 4.9x, auxiliary 2.4x, preposition 2.0x over a 0.8% base rate). It stays near its GELU floor on determiners (0.7x), coordinator 'and', complementizer 'that', NP-joining ' of' such as 'the roof of the house', nouns (0.6x), proper nouns (0.3x) and punctuation (0.4x), and its strength is not explained by surprisal or next-token entropy (Spearman +0.05/+0.01) nor by any specific upcoming token (zeroing the pole leaves top-1 probabilities unchanged, KL ~1e-3; Jacobian-lens kurtosis 3.1), so it reacts to what has already been read rather than predicting the next token.

explanation_scores.explanation: L7/N1485+ is a retrospective 'connective-slot' detector: it fires on the closed-class token that links a predicate or a quantity to its modifier - the agent/means preposition ' by' after a participle ('guided by', 'blocked by', 'made stronger by'), a causal or conditional subordinator ('because', 'due to', 'so long as'), the negation/quantifier operator inside such a phrase ('no amount of', 'not permitted'), or the pivot of a quantity/composition frame ('a wing length of', 'a combination of', 'by virtue of') - and it peaks where that token completes a formulaic multi-word connective (by-label lift 9.9x, subordinator 4.9x, auxiliary 2.4x, preposition 2.0x over a 0.8% base rate). It stays near its GELU floor on determiners (0.7x), coordinator 'and', complementizer 'that', NP-joining ' of' such as 'the roof of the house', nouns (0.6x), proper nouns (0.3x) and punctuation (0.4x), and its strength is not explained by surprisal or next-token entropy (Spearman +0.05/+0.01) nor by any specific upcoming token (zeroing the pole leaves top-1 probabilities unchanged, KL ~1e-3; Jacobian-lens kurtosis 3.1), so it reacts to what has already been read rather than predicting the next token.
